selection_rule: template index = int(sha256(task_id + ':' + turn_slot + ':' + persona_id).hexdigest(), 16) % len(pool). Deterministic: every submitter gets identical user turns.
composition: user_turn = template.replace('{task}', task_content). Task content is byte-identical across personas.
